method: 40 sole support/extreme landmarks and 14 directional extrema per dominant-bone group. Per marker: sum(bone.localToWorld * bindpose * (original position + active grip deltas) * skin weight). Reset visual branch to its serialized base, align landmark minimum with physics capsule bottom, clamp world offset to +/-0.25m. Airborne poses retain zero height correction. Dead uses whole-body landmarks. Dash/Hit fallback poses receive -/+40 degree visual yaw for right/left facing respectively. Original mesh, avatar, UVs, collider and physics root are unchanged.
